items.source: Used internally by ReactiveCqlTemplate, but also useful for application code. Note that the passed-in PreparedStatement can have been created by the framework or by a custom ReactivePreparedStatementCreator. However, the latter is hardly ever necessary, as most custom callback actions will perform updates in which case a standard PreparedStatement is fine. Custom actions will always set parameter values themselves, so that ReactivePreparedStatementCreator capability is not needed either.
items.translation: 由ReactiveCqlTemplate内部使用，但也适用于应用程序代码。请注意，传入的PreparedStatement可能由框架创建，或由自定义的ReactivePreparedStatementCreator创建。然而，后者几乎从不必要，因为大多数自定义回调操作将执行更新，此时标准的PreparedStatement即可满足需求。自定义操作始终会自行设置参数值，因此也不需要ReactivePreparedStatementCreator的功能。

items.source: Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e. a domain object or a collection of domain objects. Note that there's special support for single step actions: see ReactiveCqlTemplate.queryForObject(String, Class, Object...) etc. A thrown RuntimeException is treated as application exception, it gets propagated to the caller of the template.
items.translation: 允许返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即域对象或域对象的集合。请注意，单步操作具有特殊支持：参见 ReactiveCqlTemplate.queryForObject(String, Class, Object...) 等方法。抛出的 RuntimeException 被视为应用程序异常，将传播到模板的调用者。

items.source: Gets called by ReactiveCqlTemplate.execute(String, ReactivePreparedStatementCallback) with an active CQL session and PreparedStatement.
items.translation: 由ReactiveCqlTemplate.execute(String, ReactivePreparedStatementCallback)调用，此时拥有一个活跃的 CQL 会话和PreparedStatement。

items.source: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - if thrown by a session method, to be auto-converted to a DataAccessException.
items.translation: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 如果由会话方法抛出，将自动转换为 DataAccessException。

items.source: DataAccessException - in case of custom exceptions.
items.translation: DataAccessException - 针对自定义异常的情况。

items.source: session - active Cassandra session, must not be null.
items.translation: session - 活动的 Cassandra 会话，不能为 null。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: Generic callback interface for code that operates on a PreparedStatement. Allows to execute any number of operations on a single PreparedStatement, for example a single ReactiveSession.execute(Statement).
items.translation: 针对操作 `PreparedStatement` 的代码的通用回调接口。允许在单个 `PreparedStatement` 上执行任意数量的操作，例如单个 `ReactiveSession.execute(Statement)`。

items.source: Gets called by ReactiveCqlTemplate.execute(String, ReactivePreparedStatementCallback) with an active CQL session and PreparedStatement. Does not need to care about closing the session: this will all be handled by Spring's ReactiveCqlTemplate.
items.translation: 由ReactiveCqlTemplate.execute(String, ReactivePreparedStatementCallback)调用，传入一个活跃的 CQL 会话和PreparedStatement。无需关心关闭会话：这一切将由 Spring 的ReactiveCqlTemplate处理。
